company.shortDescription: Melio is a fintech company that delivers a digital accounts payable and receivable platform tailored for small and medium-sized businesses.
company.description: Melio is a fintech company that delivers a digital accounts payable and receivable platform tailored for small and medium-sized businesses. The platform enables users to pay invoices via ACH, credit/debit cards, or checks, and to receive payments through bank transfers or mailed checks, all from a unified dashboard. It integrates with accounting software like QuickBooks, Xero, FreshBooks, and Shopify, enabling streamlined bookkeeping and cash flow management. Melio adds features like user permissions, recurring and batch payments, virtual cards, real-time payments, and a buy‑now‑pay‑later option to offer flexible vendor payment options.
